3,889 likes, 161 comments - airbnb on October 28, 2026: "Starting today, Airbnb donates a portion of revenue from every stay to Airbnb.org to help provide short-term housing for people displaced by disaster, traveling for medical care, or facing other crises.

Guests don’t pay more and hosts don’t earn less. You’re helping simply by traveling.

Learn more at the link in bio.".
